Financial

Fund Annual Endowment Deposit Amount Installment

COA 12.12, COA 12.12.3

Each year beginning in the fiscal year SWP Contractor charges cease to be available, the Permittee deposits at least 10 percent of the PAR-required Endowment Deposit Amount, adjusted for inflation and present value, into the mutually agreed account, until the Endowment is fully funded over a maximum of 10 years. Each installment amount is as approved by CDFW in writing.

Frequency
Recurring
Timing
over a maximum 10-year period, in annual amounts of at least 10%, commencing the fiscal year that SWP charges to the SWP Contractors are no longer an available funding source

Provide Annual Long-Term HM Lands Management Funding

COA 12.12

After CDFW approves an HM lands site, the Permittee provides that site's long-term management funding every year, in the amount set by the CDFW-approved Property Analysis Record or equivalent, adjusted for inflation and for actual management costs as CDFW approves, on written terms acceptable to CDFW.

Frequency
Recurring
Timing

Reporting

Deliver Annual Status Report to CDFW

COA 10.13, COA 11.35, COA 11.36, COA 12

Permittee prepares and delivers the Annual Status Report to CDFW by January 31 each year until CDFW accepts the Final Mitigation Report. It summarizes the year's Monthly Compliance Reports, the annotated MMRP table, incidental take, disturbance acreage, the 10 percent HM lands stay-ahead demonstration for each Covered Species, the fish salvage implementation and results summary, and the annual barge monitoring summary with riverbank and vegetation imagery.

Frequency
Recurring
Timing
no later than January 31 of every year
Intake C — North Delta
Not StartedDue 2026-12-171 of 3 done
Bethany Reservoir Aqueduct
Not StartedDue 2026-12-041 of 3 done

Deliver Final Phase Mitigation Report to CDFW

COA 10.15

Within 45 days of completing Covered Activities and all mitigation measures for a Project Phase — and again after all Phases are complete — the Designated Biologist or Biological Monitor prepares and Permittee delivers a Final Phase Mitigation Report to CDFW summarizing the Phase's Monthly Compliance Reports and Annual Status Reports, MMRP implementation dates, incidental take and impacts, Covered Activity start and end dates, an effectiveness assessment and recommendations.

Frequency
One time
Timing
no later than 45 days after completion of Covered Activities and all mitigation measures for each Project Phase
Twin Cities Complex
Not StartedDue 2026-07-10

Notify CDFW of Likely Impact Exceedance and Revised Schedule

COA 10.9

When impacts tracked for the Annual Status Report are likely to exceed the permanent or temporary impacts CDFW approved for any Covered Species, Permittee notifies CDFW and submits a revised Project Phase schedule within 10 business days of that notice, keeping temporary impacts within the COA 11.66 and 12.3 criteria.

Frequency
As needed
Timing
within 10 business days of the notification
Intake C — North Delta
Not Started

Notify CDFW of TRBL Colony or Roost Disturbance

COA 11.86, COA 11.88

The Designated Biologist or Biological Monitor consults CDFW immediately when a TRBL colony is at risk, notifies CDFW within 24 hours when Covered Activities are stopped for disrupting a colony or when nests or nestlings are abandoned, works with CDFW on actions for surviving nestlings, contacts CDFW when roost protective measures are not reducing disruption, and files a written incident report within two days that is carried into the Monthly Compliance Report and Annual Status Report.

Frequency

Timing

guide.intent: An action list as the PDF its Export card downloads: title block, a summary table with one line per action, then every action in full from a new page, grouped by action type.
decisions: Print route: `action-list/:actionListID` in print.routes.ts, a child of PrintLayoutComponent beside `report/:reportID`, guarded by printAuthGuard.
Data: the endpoint the list's tracking tree and the CSV already read, `actionListsActionListIDTrackingGet` (ActionListTrackingActionDto[]), plus the list detail for its Name and Description.
Per action: Name, RequirementType (the group), FrequencyName, Commitments' codes, and ActionImplementations for the status lines.
Download: `GET action-lists/{actionListID}/generate-pdf`, the same shape as the obligation list's, file named `{list.Name}.pdf`. Letter paper via the PdfService paper option.
Groups are action types, A–Z, actions A–Z inside each. One level only, so entry titles sit one heading level below the type.
gotchas: ActionListTrackingActionDto has no description and no timing. Extend it with the action's Text (printed as the description) rather than fetching each action.

Timing in the prototype is the permit's stated timing sentence. Prod stores the schedule as structured fields (ActionScheduleDto: deadline milestone and offset, recurrence). If no stated-timing text exists, print the schedule as one sentence or leave Timing off; do not invent a field.
The CSV keeps one row per occurrence. The PDF does not: see the next section.
acceptance: Every action on the list appears once in the summary and once in the detail, under its type, in the same order in both.

guide.intent: One action in the detail: title with commitment codes at the right margin, description, a facts row (Frequency, Timing), then one line per component saying where the action stands there.
decisions: One line per scope, not per occurrence (round 1). Scope is ComponentName, or ProjectName when the action is done once for the project.

Each line names the occurrence that is open now: the first implementation by SequenceNumber that is not Completed, or the last one when all are. It prints that occurrence's status (occurrenceStatusLabel, the same label the tree uses), its due date (EditedDueDate, else DueDate, YYYY-MM-DD), and "N of M done" when the scope has more than one occurrence.
Status is a plain word, not a pill: a printed page cannot rely on color, and a tinted chip prints as a gray box.
No due date on a Completed line, and none when the occurrence has none (as-needed actions).
gotchas: An implementation marked IsNotApplicable prints "Not Applicable" (NOT_APPLICABLE_LABEL), as the CSV does, and does not count toward "N of M done".
Keep the whole entry together on a page (`break-inside: avoid`); a status list split from its action is unreadable.
acceptance: A recurring action on three components prints three lines, each with the open occurrence's status, its due date, and "k of n done".
